description: WHEN TO USE: Inspects authenticated Etuki gateway execution evidence for a single inference request to verify which model and effort actually ran. DO NOT USE: For session quota-endurance math or unauthenticated budget scenarios (use detect_model_downgrade_and_substitution). INPUTS & DEFAULTS: Pass request_id (UUID) or install_id (UUID); if request_id is omitted, install_id must map to a single active request, and host env/catalog labels are never treated as execution proof. BEHAVIOR: Read-only lookup sending zero inference probes. OUTPUT: JSON with classification, evidence_source, requested_model, forwarded_model, reported_model, and policy downgrade flags.

install_id.description: Expected tenant installation UUID (RFC 4122). Scopes lookup strictly to the authenticated tenant.

request_id.description: Exact gateway observation UUID (RFC 4122). If omitted, a bound installation with exactly one active request is required.

name: get_model_identity
